thread:
kevin: CI perf alert — nightly perf job shows ~18% p50 increase and 30% p99 spike for small-batch KV-heavy routes after infra base image bumped to driver 12.7.p1. https://grafana.internal/d/small-batch
ci-bot: perf-ci: regression detected for perf-suite/nightly (run 2026-03-17) — see details above
nina: is this coming from the driver bump or a merged runtime change?
kevin: infra merged driver bump last night (image: redwood-runtime:2026-03-16-driver12.7p1). no other runtime merges in the window
david: I reproduced locally on a100 with driver 12.7.p1. Kernel selection flipped during matmul for seq_len 32 / batch 8. profiler snippet:
```
nsys profile summary:
Kernel matmul_f32_warp — 1.8ms (dominant)
Kernel matmul_f32_cn — 0.6ms (previously dominant)
```
This increases per-token work and spikes KV cache latency due to scheduling alignment
anita: KV stats from staging: cache hit rate dropped 94%->80% for 32/8 workload, prefetch queue length +45%, CPU scheduling wait increased. Throughput down ~20%
maria: Triton autotune seems to have repopulated the autotune table after driver change, choosing a different matmul path. We saw similar behavior after minor lib bumps before
kevin: tried forcing previous kernel selection via env — `TRITON_DISABLE_AUTOTUNE=1` and `RW_MATMUL_SELECTOR=legacy_path` — quick smoke locally brought p50 back to baseline :thumbsup:
ops-bot: rollback: staging image redwood-runtime:2026-03-16-driver12.7p1 -> redwood-runtime:2026-03-14-driver12.7. rollback job queued
nina: good. we should bisect driver patch to find which change affected scheduling heuristics (driver vs libcudnn vs nvrtc). can we run CI matrix with driver 12.7 and 12.7.p1 and old 12.6?
david: I'll produce a small reproducible invocation for perf-ci to run across driver variants. Reproducer (run on an a100, 8g worker):
```
python perf_repro.py --model llama-7b --seq 32 --batch 8 --kv-pattern prefix-heavy --iter 200 --trace nsight
```
triton-bot: autotune table change detected: new entry matmul_f32_warp added for sm_80 after driver update
anita: runtime config can force kernel_selector_override in /etc/redwood/runtime.toml — we can pin until a proper fix. example:
```
[kernel_override]
matmul = "matmul_f32_cn"
```
kevin: opening rollback PR to pin the image for staging and gate rollout to prod. also filing ticket RW-7890 to track bisect + fix. I'll run bisect tomorrow morning across driver patches and cuDNN builds
ci-bot: perf-ci: queued bisect matrix jobs (3 variants). will post results when done
maria: FYI: hold Dedicated customer deploys on this image until we confirm revert effectiveness — raising customer alert
kevin: noted. will update here with timeline once rollback completes
nina: thanks — appreciate the quick hold. :eyes:
ci-bot: perf-ci: two runs failed with p99 regression on a100 small-batch, links: https://ci.internal/job/2345 and https://ci.internal/job/2346
kevin: OK locking rollout and running the bisect. if bisect points to driver micropatch we'll coordinate with infra to request a fix/backport or pin to older driver on hosts
maria: will notify CS to expect a short outage window for staging metrics during rollback
kevin: closing loop here once bisect finishes, will avoid broad prod rollout until root cause confirmed
